info.name: [DEPRECATION NOTE: PHASED OUT ENDPOINT IN FAVOR OF CORETIME] Get the status of the current auction.

params.name: at
params.description: Block at which to retrieve auction progress at.

items.docs:
Returns an overview of the current auction. There is only one auction
at a time. If there is no auction most fields will be `null`. If the current
auction phase is in `vrfDelay` and you are looking to retrieve the latest winning
bids, it is advised to query one block before `finishEnd` in the `endingPeriod` phase
for that auction as there technically are no winners during the `vrfDelay` and thus
the field is `null`.

info.name: Get relay chain inclusion information for a specific parachain block.

params.name: number
params.description: Parachain block number to find inclusion information for.

params.name: depth
params.description: Maximum number of relay chain blocks to search for inclusion (must be divisible by 5, max 100).

items.docs:
Returns the relay chain block number where a parachain block was included,
along with the relay parent number used during production. This endpoint helps
track the lifecycle of parachain blocks from production to inclusion.

**Note**: This endpoint requires a multi-chain connection (both parachain and relay chain APIs).
